title: Why America Basically Killed The Landline
hook: Why does every unknown number feel like a scam call now?
closing: Your phone still rings. Most of the time, it isn't for you.
question: Do you still answer unknown numbers?

segments.say: By 2024, 76 percent of US adults had no landline at all, up from a quarter in 2010.
22 percent of all robocalls Americans got were straight-up scams, with telemarketing close behind.
Americans got about 52.8 billion robocalls in 2024, nearly double what they got in 2016.
